description: A resonant filter bank at USER-CHOSEN fixed frequencies - the free-tuning sibling of the curated harmonic 'filter bank' modes. Pinned to submode 1 (filter pitches in Hz; submode 2 takes MIDI values, same argv). The fbank parameter is an auxiliary text file (write_data_file()): one 'pitch amp' pair per line; amps numeric 0.001-10000 or dB ('-6dB' verified); ';' comments legal. Error surface verbatim: 'Not enough values on line 1: file ...' (a frequency-only list - e.g. raw filter bankfrqs output - is REFUSED; amplitudes must be added); pitch checked in-file at 0.1-22050 Hz ('frq (30000.000) on line 1 out of range (0.1 to 22050.0):file ...'). Output duration is exactly indur + tail with the family's UNDOCUMENTED tail default of 1.0 s (2 s -> 3.0000 with no -t; -t2 -> 4.0; -t0.5 -> 2.5, all sample-exact); the entry pins tail explicitly. Q is time-variable (breakpoint verified: differs from both scalar-endpoint renders); gain and tail refuse brk files. Fully deterministic (no scatter path). Mono and stereo accepted. Does NOT run the filter-bank normalization pre-pass (FLTBANKU never sets do_norm, filters0.c) - the P5-1 vintage-binary hang does not apply; version_sensitive false.
musical_use: Tune any material to any chord, scale or spectrum: write the frequencies you want (a chord's notes, measured formants, a bankfrqs-generated series with hand-edited amps) and the bank rings exactly those. Per-filter amplitude is the voicing control the harmonic bank lacks - weight the fundamental heavily and let upper resonances whisper, or notch a member to 0.001 without removing the line. Low Q (1-20) colours the source; high Q (hundreds+) turns transients into ringing chords - raise gain substantially as Q climbs. A time-varying Q breakpoint morphs coloured noise into pure ringing. Pairs naturally with filter bankfrqs (generate a frequency list, add amps, feed it here) and is the fixed-frequency little sibling of varibank (whose bands move over time).

fbank.description: REQUIRED text file (write_data_file(); any extension except .brk): one 'pitch amp' pair per line, pitch in Hz 0.1-22050 (enforced in-file), amp 0.001-10000 or dB. ';' comments legal. Frequency-only lists refused ('Not enough values on line 1') - add amplitudes to bankfrqs output before use. Resolved against the session's data/ directory.

q.description: Filter tightness (CDP-enforced 0.001 to 10000, verbatim refusal probed). Time-variable and VERIFIED: a 20->500 breakpoint rendered and differs from both scalar-endpoint renders.

gain.description: Overall makeup gain (CDP-enforced 0.001 to 10000; 20000 refused verbatim). High Q needs high gain. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 2 [...]: brkpnt_files not permitted.').

tail.description: Ring-out time appended after the input; output = indur + tail exactly. UNDOCUMENTED default 1.0 s (family finding, re-verified here); the entry emits -t explicitly. tail = 0 triggers the family buffer bug (garbage tail whose length depends on the CDP buffer size - 244690 frames observed at BBSIZE 8000, 262144 at default); curated minimum 0.01 keeps it unreachable. Breakpoint refused ('Cannot read parameter 6').

double.description: Double filtering - steeper rolloff (verified: changes the render, duration unchanged).

examples.description: Ring a minor-ninth voicing out of noise, fundamental weighted, long decay.
examples.expected_use:
First write_data_file('fb_chord.txt', '110 1.0
220 0.5
261.6 0.4
330 0.4
466.2 0.25'). Pitched bell-chord resonance; output = indur + 2.

examples.description: Coloured-noise to pure-ring morph via time-varying Q.
examples.expected_use: Breakpoint Q (relative times); tail stays at the pinned 1.0 default, output = indur + 1.

known_issues: UNDOCUMENTED tail default 1.0 s (family finding re-verified in this mode: 2 s in -> 3.0000 out with no -t, sample-exact) - the entry always emits -t so the duration model holds.

tail = 0 is accepted but buggy: the output balloons with a garbage-silence tail whose length tracks the CDP buffer size (5.55 s from a 2 s input at CDP_MEMORY_BBSIZE=8000; the fixed 262144 frames of the bank precedent at the default buffer). Curated minimum 0.01 avoids it.

Raw 'filter bankfrqs' output is NOT accepted (frequency column only): 'ERROR: Not enough values on line 1: file ...' - amplitudes must be appended to every line first, exactly as the bankfrqs banner warns.
The fbank pitch column's real in-file range is 0.1-22050 Hz, not the banner's '0Hz to sr/3'.
Only Q accepts breakpoint files (verified against both endpoints); gain refuses as parameter 2, tail as parameter 6 (CDP's brk-stage numbering).
Deterministic (two runs 1.2 s apart byte-identical in decoded samples); no scatter/random path exists in this mode.
No normalization pre-pass runs here (source: filters0.c do_norm only for FLTBANKN/V/V2) - the vintage-binary bank hang (P5-1) does not apply.
Submode 2 (MIDI pitches in the file) verified working, same argv - separate triple, not curated.
